description: This file defines a StringCodec class responsible for serializing and deserializing string objects within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes methods for reading and writing string data, handling raw byte sequences, and managing references.

classes.name: StringCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec<string> for serializing and deserializing strings in Orleans serialization.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a string value from the reader, handling reference types and length-prefixed strings.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads raw string content from the reader, either directly or via multi-segment reading.

methods.name: ReadMultiSegment
methods.description: Reads string data spanning multiple segments when it cannot be read contiguously.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a string field, including reference handling and length-prefixed encoding.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes raw string data into the buffer, either directly or via multi-segment encoding.

methods.name: WriteMultiSegment
methods.description: Handles writing string data across multiple segments when it cannot fit into a single span.
